scope: Natural astronomical science validation only; not artificial transmitter identity or automatic suppression.

berkeley.scope: Exact catalogue source/role and dates; no inference of OFF from different field or name substring.

frame_evidence.reference: Lebofsky et al 2019, section 2.3 and figure 5: documented topocentric example; filterbank frequency grid from raw OBSFREQ/OBSBW. Evidence supports conventional topocentric interpretation; exact W3OH processing lineage not yet verified.
frame_evidence.header_flags_required: Inspect FITS SPECSYS, CTYPE1, VELDEF, SSYSOBS and frame codes as supplied; never assume absent flags mean explicit topocentric.
frame_evidence.scope: SDFITS frame applies to SDFITS only; cannot transfer it automatically to BL HDF5.

gate: Independent date and documented SIG/REF qualified separately from position ON/OFF; no natural-line proof from metadata; G4/R28 unchanged.
